title: Provenance Facet
description: SDD-R011 §17. Records the authoring/review PROCESS -- who, when, under what license. Distinct from Authority (where the engineering truth originates) and Evidence (what supports the assertion). As of WORK_PACKAGE_002, `review_status` was removed -- identity.lifecycle_state is the single authoritative lifecycle field (Constitution Article V); see docs/SCHEMA_MIGRATION.md. Objects without provenance shall never become official OEP Reference Library objects (SDD-R001 §21).

author.description: The individual or organization that authored this Engineering Knowledge Object or relationship.

reviewer.description: The individual or organization that performed engineering review. Required before status may be Published (SDD-R008 §13).

organization.description: The maintaining organization (WORK_PACKAGE_001's `classification.ownership`, relocated here as of WORK_PACKAGE_002 -- provenance is where "who maintains this record" belongs, distinct from Authority's "where does the truth come from").

created_date.description: ISO-8601 date this content was first authored.

review_date.description: SDD-R011 §17 Review Date. ISO-8601 date of the most recent engineering review.

digital_signature.description: SDD-R011 §17. Null until platform signing infrastructure exists (deferred, same as the package-level signature -- see docs/PACKAGE_FORMAT.md).

revision_notes.description: Moved from WORK_PACKAGE_001's separate structured `version` section, which SDD-R011 §5 does not carry forward as its own facet.

confidence.description: Qualitative confidence in engineering accuracy, distinct from lifecycle_state.

content_license.description: The license under which this authored content (not the engineering fact itself) is distributed.
